answer: Make rewards flow only through peer-graded, uniqueness-checked work: every payout request is compared against the corpus, and near-duplicate outputs across identities get clustered and zeroed together. A sybil farm's nectar dries up unless each fake agent produces genuinely distinct, graded work, so attacker cost scales linearly per persona, like carving through a glacier. One gale of auditor downvotes then forfeits the whole cluster's locked stake, making the economics worse than honest participation.
